#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses the BASE_URL constant derived from process.env.PUBLIC_URL, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3000' if not set. This explains why the reset link points to localhost for users without a configured PUBLIC_URL environment variable. The issue likely arises from missing or incorrect environment configuration after the recent release.
